rationale: C22 is a highly specific drafting template: it concerns carriers represented by the same three regional conference committees, uses the same three-part Railway Labor Act predicate, requires the board's report within thirty days, and imposes the identical section 10 standstill period. The child principally substitutes the represented labor organizations and makes minor wording corrections. C07 and C11 share the same operative machinery, but their party structures are less closely matched.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a dispute exists between the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, and the Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee
shared_material.parent_excerpt: a dispute exists between the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, Western Carriers' Conference Committee and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive three-committee carrier structure appears in both directives.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS this dispute has not heretofore been adjusted under the provisions of the Railway Labor Act, as amended
shared_material.explanation: The statutory predicate is reproduced verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The board shall report its findings to the President with respect to the said dispute within thirty days from the date of this order.
shared_material.explanation: The principal reporting provision is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the Board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement, shall be made by the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, the Western Carriers' Conference Committee, or the Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee, or their employees
shared_material.parent_excerpt: As provided by section 10 of the Railway Labor Act, as amended, from this date and for thirty days after the Board has made its report to the President, no change, except by agreement shall be made by the carriers represented by the Eastern Carriers' Conference Committee, Western Carriers' Committee and Southeastern Carriers' Conference Committee, or their employees
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory standstill mechanism is applied to essentially the same specifically identified carrier group.
